concept: Staying composed and following through under real pressure (a big test, a performance, a deadline)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student navigates a high-pressure moment (exam, performance, deadline) where panic would derail preparation already done
exercise.branching_choice: Student chooses how to respond to the pressure in the moment
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what staying composed actually looked like versus what panic would have looked like

assessment.success_marker: student distinguishes a specific composed response from a specific panicked one, not just in the abstract
